Using \(a=\frac{2}{\sqrt{x}}\) and \(b=-x\),

\[
\left(\frac{2}{\sqrt{x}}-x\right)^9=\sum_{k=0}^9 \binom{9}{k}\left(\frac{2}{\sqrt{x}}\right)^{9-k}(-x)^k.
\]

The constant term occurs when the exponent of \(x\) is \(0\):

\[
k-\frac{9-k}{2}=0 \implies 3k-9=0 \implies k=3.
\]

So the constant term is

\[
\binom{9}{3}2^6(-1)^3 = -84\cdot 64 = -5376.
\]

The sum of all coefficients is found by setting \(x=1\):

\[
(2-1)^9=1.
\]

Thus the sum of coefficients excluding the constant term is

\[
1-(-5376)=5377.
\]

\[
\boxed{5377}
\]
